next_edition.label: 15th anniversary edition (planned 27 to 29 Nov 2026) suspended; organiser seeking a new venue

attendance.note: Press (El Día) said the first edition in 2011 drew 'más de 30.000 visitantes' (over 30,000 visitors). Google snippet only; no recent figure.

Organiser post (31 Oct 2025) moved the 15th anniversary edition to 27 to 29 Nov 2026 at Pasaje Dardo Rocha, before the suspension.
Google snippet: first edition 2011 at Pasaje Dardo Rocha 'convocó a más de 30.000 visitantes'.
'nuevo sponsor oficial del 15 aniversario': Tribo do Sol (tattoo supplies).
'Sponsor oficial del 15th anniv.': World Famous Ink, supporting the event for 15 years.
